title: TripRequest
description: A passenger's request for an on-demand transport service between two points. v2.1 adds V1 ONDC TRV10 BAP preference fields for the select phase alongside the v2.0 route fields.

origin.description: Pickup location for the ride. Maps to V1 fulfillments[].stops[type=START].location.

destination.description: Dropoff location for the ride. Maps to V1 fulfillments[].stops[type=END].location.

vehiclePreference.description: Broad vehicle category requested (e.g. FOUR_WHEELER). Maps to V1 fulfillments[].vehicle.category.

vehicleVariant.description: Specific vehicle body type requested (e.g. SEDAN, HATCHBACK, SUV_PLUS). Maps to V1 fulfillments[].vehicle.variant.

filters.description: JSONPath filter criteria applied to search results

spatial.description: Geographic constraints on the search area

provider.description: Identifier of a specific provider to search within

customerDisabilityDisable.description: Whether the customer has declared a disability exemption. Maps to V1 items[].tags[CUSTOMER_INFO].CUSTOMER_DISABILITY_DISABLE.

isPetRide.description: Whether the customer is travelling with a pet. Maps to V1 items[].tags[PET_ORDER_INFO].IS_PET_RIDE.

billingCategory.description: Billing category for this ride (e.g. PERSONAL, BUSINESS). Maps to V1 items[].tags[BILLING_CATEGORY_INFO].BILLING_CATEGORY.

isAutoAssignEnabled.description: Whether the BAP requests automatic driver assignment. Maps to V1 items[].tags[AUTO_ASSIGN_ENABLED].IS_AUTO_ASSIGN_ENABLED.

isForwardBatchEnabled.description: Whether forward batching of the ride request is enabled. Maps to V1 items[].tags[FORWARD_BATCHING_REQUEST_INFO].IS_FORWARD_BATCH_ENABLED.

toUpdateDeviceId.description: Whether the BPP should update the stored device ID. Maps to V1 items[].tags[DEVICE_ID_INFO].TO_UPDATE_DEVICE_ID.

preferSafetyPlus.description: Whether the customer prefers a Safety Plus driver. Maps to V1 items[].tags[SAFETY_PLUS_INFO].PREFER_SAFETY_PLUS.

emailDomain.description: Email domain of the customer's account for corporate ride identification. Maps to V1 items[].tags[EMAIL_DOMAIN_INFO].EMAIL_DOMAIN.

confirmedPrice.description: Fare amount the BAP is confirming from the on_discover response. Maps to V1 items[].price.

tags.description: V1-compatible tag groups preserved verbatim for lossless V2→V1 round-trip.
